paywall.lead: The rest of this article is available after unlocking.
paywall.permanent: You pay once, with no subscription. The article stays yours.
drawerSteps: Tap Unlock — no account, no card and no app to install.
Send the text message your phone prepares for you. It is only the confirmation — you can cancel it.
The article appears right away, without moving where you were reading. Once unlocked, it stays that way.
paywall.drawerWhyText: It is the one confirmation that works on every phone. No card form, no wallet and no password — one tap and a confirmation.
paywall.drawerPremiumText: No. This is not a premium service and not a subscription. There are no hidden weekly charges and no renewals. You pay once, for one article.
paywall.drawerTrust: No card · No account · No renewal
